programme.desc: In the late 1970s, the FBI had a working knowledge of anti-Castro terrorists operating in the United States. But then a new group appeared, more violent and aggressive than their predecessors.

programme.title: Who Gets The Dog

programme.title: How to Be

programme.title: Boomerang: There U Go

programme.title: Boomerang: Love Shoulda Brought You Home

programme.title: Being Mary Jane: Freedom

programme.title: Lyxfällan Danmark
programme.desc: Daniels relation till pengar är så impulsiv och behovsstyrd att den har äventyrat hans förhållande till hans gravida flickvän. På ett år har han spenderat 55.000 kr på snabbmat, bensin och mat som levereras till dörren.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Danmark

programme.title: Lyxfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 2508
programme.desc: I Munkebo drömmer 24-åriga Maria och 34-årige Anders om att köpa ett hus och en bebis, men drömmen är helt orealistisk - för i Anders förflutna med både droger och brott har han byggt upp en stor skuld.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 2502

programme.title: Lyxfällan Danmark
programme.desc: Niels drömmer om ett liv med Malene. Men för att det ska bli verklighet måste Niels reda ut sin kaotiska ekonomi, som inkluderar snabblån, obetalda räkningar och skulder.

programme.desc: The 1996 investigation into 48-year-old Martha Hansen's murder is helped by a legal requirement that bars have video cameras installed on the premises.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Elephant Tracks
programme.desc: The murders of an elderly couple leave police stumped until, two years later, they receive a major break. A jeweler looking through old newspaper clippings recognizes a necklace the female victim wore as having been pawned in her own shop.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Bag of Evidence
programme.desc: While investigating the murder of 9-year-old Jessica Knott, police use a garbage bag to connect suspect James Edward Crow, Jr. to the crime.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Tooth or Consequences
programme.desc: An investigation into the murder of Katie Poirier is stymied by the lack of a body. Finally, investigators use a single tooth found among some charred remains to identify her.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Scratching The Surface
programme.desc: The only clue recovered from a shooting is a twelve-guage shotgun. Scientists use unique methods to lift the serial number from the weapon to trace it to its owner

programme.title: Forensic Files: Fire Proof
programme.desc: A serial arsonist starts several fires that cause millions of dollars worth of damage and the deaths of three people. He is discovered, partly through the use of forensic hypnosis.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Breaking the Mold
programme.desc: A three-year-old develops a respiratory condition. His father has Alzheimers. An investigator reveals that their ill health is due to mold in their modern home.

programme.title: Forensic Files: House Call
programme.desc: A murder investigation in Florida crosses jurisdictions from New York and Jamaica. The police rely on cell phone mapping, wiretapping and a host of forensic evidence to link a suspect to a murder.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Above the Law
programme.desc: California Highway Patrolman George Gwaltney discovered the body of 23-year-old Robin Bishop near her car on a remote desert highway.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Human Prey
programme.desc: Thomas Dillon killed five outdoorsmen at random over a period of three years in rural southern Ohio. After a tip led the FBI to the murder weapon, ballistic testing made a match.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Death in Alaska
programme.desc: The day began like any other for Cheryl and Paul Chapman, until the silence of a peaceful Sunday morning was shattered with a phone call.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Paradise
programme.desc: It should have been Shangri-La, but when bad blood developed, piracy took over and the only law was the law of the jungle.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Crazy Don
programme.desc: To the FBI, he was believed to be the boss of New York's most powerful mafia organizationthe Genovese crime family. Was Gigante crazy or was his behavior a shrewd attempt to disguise his position as a ruthless mafia boss?

programme.title: The New Detectives: Living In Terror
programme.desc: Terrorism: Thanks to new technology and, perhaps, the approaching millennium, terrorism is a growing international threat. The Oklahoma City explosion and the bombing of the World Trade Center are just two of the incidents of this growing problem.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Tainted Trust
programme.desc: Poison is the subtlest form of death, and investigators must see through unusual circumstances to bring these murders to light.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Predators and Parasites
programme.desc: For the forensic entomologist, the insects that nest in dead bodies are like tiny witnesses to a crime.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Face Of Tragedy
programme.desc: Forensic Sculpting: Forensic sculptors retrieve people from oblivion. Using clay and an intricate knowledge of anatomy, forensic arts place a face on an unidentified skull, recreating the victim's likeness, which often leads to his name.

programme.title: The New Detectives: To Kill Again
programme.desc: Some people do get away with murder at least for a while. Flush with their success, serial killers murder again and again. But each time they kill, they leave behind a few more clues, which ultimately lead to their capture.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Make My Day
programme.desc: When Keith Andrews is killed, a man steps forward claiming he did it in self-defense—but Lt. Joe Kenda has his doubts.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: The Shoelace Killer
programme.desc: A party on the outskirts of the city turns into a nightmare for some teenagers when they discover a woman’s corpse.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Worst I’ve Ever Seen
programme.desc: Two grandparents are shot to death in their family home. Kenda’s investigation kicks into high gear when his prime suspect flees for the Mexican border.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: 12 Years a Fugitive
programme.desc: When a beloved grandmother is found stabbed to death in her own home, Kenda must turn to a tight-knit community still grieving from the tragic loss.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Murder Bites
programme.desc: A young woman is found naked and strangled in a park not 200 yards from her home. It isn’t until Lt. Joe Kenda rethinks the entire case that he realizes someone has been lying.

programme.title: COPS: Dead End Dash
programme.desc: An officer tracks a suspect down a treacherous cliffside, a man puts his brother and elderly father at risk, and a man asks police to take his son to jail.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: The Master Key
programme.desc: When a pregnant mother and her two young sons are brutally slain, pressure mounts for the CSPD to catch the cold-blooded monster who did it.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: #1 Suspect
programme.desc: Lt. Joe Kenda must somehow solve a stranger-on-stranger crime with just a composite sketch of the killer and a mysterious bouquet of flowers.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Magic Bullet
programme.desc: A hard-working father of two is shot in the head just steps from a notorious strip club. The case is stuck in neutral until Kenda uncovers a conspiracy organized by an unlikely triggerman.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: A Prayer for the Dying
programme.desc: A mother of two is found dead in the most expensive part of Colorado Springs, leaving Lt. Joe Kenda stumped—until he looks into her personal life.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Bump In the Night
programme.desc: When a pretty, young pilot is found in bed, bound and with a bullet in her head, Lt. Joe Kenda must determine if this was a random assault or payback for something that happened in the skies.

programme.title: Corporate: Remember Day
programme.desc: Matt bearbetar sitt familjetrauma genom att kasta sig in i kontorets helgfest, Christian ifrågasätter sin världsbild, och Jake överväger att lämna firman.

programme.title: South Park: Skogsdjurens jul
programme.desc: Tomten måste döda de onda djuren i South Park och rädda världen efter att de fått Stan att hjälpa dem med födelsen av deras frälsare.

programme.title: Workaholics: The Strike
programme.desc: När Alice vägrar ge killarna ledigt för fejkhögtiden 'halvjul' bestämmer de sig för att strejka för bättre arbetsvillkor.

programme.title: South Park: En väldigt sugig jul
programme.desc: Kyle och Ike väntar nervöst på Mr Hankey. När han inte dyker upp kallar Kyle samman de andra för ett sent krismöte.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Secret Santa
programme.desc: What were those strange lights in the desert? Who are these new Reno Sheriff's Department deputies?

programme.title: Tosh.0: Black Santa
programme.desc: I det här julavsnittet tar Daniel reda på vem som sköt den svarte jultomten, visar sin värsta "jag är bättre än dig, bajs i ditt fejs" och avslöjar ett gammalt familjerecept.

programme.title: South Park: God jul, Charlie Manson!
programme.desc: Farbror Howard rymmer från fängelset tillsammans med en annan intern, Charlie Manson. Charlie är redo att njuta av sin frihet men blir distraherad av ett specialinspelat julprogram.

programme.title: South Park: Julesnö
programme.desc: Jultomten stjäl all glädje från stadens julhelg.

programme.title: South Park: Röd släde nedskjuten
programme.desc: Cartman tar jultomten, Mr. Hankey och Jesus till hjälp för att försöka skänka julkänsla till de förtryckta massorna i Irak - allt för att hamna på tomtens lista över snälla barn.

programme.title: South Park: Jul i Kanada
programme.desc: Kyles adopterade bror Ike hämtas tillbaka till Kanada av hans biologiska föräldrar eftersom den nya kanadensiska premiärministern har bestämt att alla barn som adopterats från Kanada måste lämnas tillbaka.

programme.title: iCarly: En dejt med Freddie

programme.title: iCarly: Älskar konst

programme.title: iCarly: Jag vill inte bråka

programme.title: iCarly: Läskigt på Halloween

programme.title: iCarly: Ångra dagen

programme.title: iCarly: Kvarsittning
programme.desc: Sam får kvarsittning samma kväll som det är iCarlys spektakulära, femtionde webbshow. Eftersom de inte kan göra sin planerade webbshow, gör Carly och Freddie sitt bästa för att också få kvarsittning, så att de kan göra showen på kvarsittningen.

programme.title: The FBI Files

programme.title: Forensic Files: House Call
programme.desc: A murder investigation in Florida crosses jurisdictions from New York and Jamaica. The police rely on cell phone mapping, wiretapping and a host of forensic evidence to link a suspect to a murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Plastic Fire
programme.desc: A woman convicted of killing her mother in a car fire is granted a new trial. An expert witness has a different opinion as to how the fire started and, if proven, would clear the woman of any culpability.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Last Will
programme.desc: Authorities track a kidnapper who let his victim write a last will and informed the family of her murder. A phone number written on a previous page left a lasting impression, which helped to convict.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dessert Served Cold
programme.desc: A man dies in his home after a long history of heart disease. A few weeks after the funeral, rumors surface that the death was no accident.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Music Case
programme.desc: In 1999, a 12-year-old was found murdered in her Minnesota home. Despite a meticulous search of the home and an exhaustive investigation, police had no suspects.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Paintball
programme.desc: In 1962, the small town residents of Hanford, California lost their sense of peace when one of their own, 15-year-old Marlene Miller, was murdered.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sign Here
programme.desc: A mother of two vanishes after a shopping trip. Her body is discovered a month later, and witnesses say they saw the victim being forced into a car by an unknown person.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Shadow of a Doubt
programme.desc: A woman is shot to death in her store just one day before she is to testify against the man accused of robbing her. The robber becomes the prime suspect, but he has a solid alibi: a timestamped videotape of his activities on the day of the murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Tourist Trap
programme.desc: In 1993, the state of Florida was known for more than just Disney World. Worldwide attention focused on a rash of robberies which targeted tourists. Some vacationers were killed in these attacks, but some fought and survived.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Once Bitten
programme.desc: Investigators find a shoe print, several foreign hairs and unknown fingerprints at a murder scene. But they believe the most telling piece of evidence is the bite mark on the victim's chest.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Crazy Don
programme.desc: To the FBI, he was believed to be the boss of New York's most powerful mafia organizationthe Genovese crime family. Was Gigante crazy or was his behavior a shrewd attempt to disguise his position as a ruthless mafia boss?

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killing Spree
programme.desc: In 1984, in South Florida, a rapist and murderer was on the loose. The killer was a ruthless and terrifying predator, the newest member of an infamous group known as serial killers.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Melissa Brannen: Missing
programme.desc: In 1989, residents of a close-knit apartment community in Virginia gathered for a holiday celebration. For Tammy Brannen and five-year-old daughter Melissa, Christmas was always a special time. Then without warning, the little girl was gone.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Unabomber
programme.desc: For nearly two decades a mathematical genius with delusions of single-handedly destroying industrial society, planted or mailed powerful bombs to unsuspecting innocent victims.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Murdering Cowboy
programme.desc: The sun set on the Wild West long ago, but some people refused to notice. Claude Dallas was one of them. A wily trapper, Dallas typified the rugged individualism that forged this country. He went too far when he killed two game wardens in 1981.

programme.title: The New Detectives: To Kill Again
programme.desc: Some people do get away with murder at least for a while. Flush with their success, serial killers murder again and again. But each time they kill, they leave behind a few more clues, which ultimately lead to their capture.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Elements Of Murder
programme.desc: There are several things that can suggest murder; jealousy, anger, poison. When everyday substances reveal hidden clues that break a homicide case, those substances become the elements of murder.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Fatal Compulsion
programme.desc: Forensic psychologists delve into the minds of serial killers, explaining why, most often, they can be a friendly neighbor or the tenacious co-worker: the one who hides his or her dark side better than anyone else.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Deadly Target
programme.desc: Ballistics: A corpse is found with a gunshot wound to the head; the weapon lies next to the victim. It looks like suicide, but could it be murder? It's a question best solved by ballistics experts.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Random Targets
programme.desc: Most victims of multiple murderers are meticulously chosen because of a mutual connection with the killer or because they match an intricate set of criteria that fits the killer's MO.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Murder Bites
programme.desc: A young woman is found naked and strangled in a park not 200 yards from her home. It isn’t until Lt. Joe Kenda rethinks the entire case that he realizes someone has been lying.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Winter’s Bone
programme.desc: High in the mountains above Colorado Springs, a woman’s frozen body is found along a switchback road. Investigators need to figure out what brought her here in the first place.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: #1 Suspect
programme.desc: Lt. Joe Kenda must somehow solve a stranger-on-stranger crime with just a composite sketch of the killer and a mysterious bouquet of flowers.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Bad Things Come in Threes
programme.desc: When two young mothers are gunned down behind a crowded bar, Kenda has to first determine who was the intended target and who was collateral damage.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Lockdown
programme.desc: When a crazed gunman terrorizes his neighborhood, officers put themselves in the line of fire to restore order.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Bump In the Night
programme.desc: When a pretty, young pilot is found in bed, bound and with a bullet in her head, Lt. Joe Kenda must determine if this was a random assault or payback for something that happened in the skies.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: My First Case
programme.desc: In his first case with the homicide unit, rookie burglary detective Joe Kenda volunteers to work a bloody multi-victim shooting deemed “unsolvable” by the veterans.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Getting Away with Murder?
programme.desc: A report on families who have experienced the violent death of a loved one and believe they know the identity of the killer but lack evidence to back the charge.

programme.title: 48 Hours: A Mother Accused
programme.desc: This report investigates alleged incidents of Shaken Baby Syndrome, focusing on accusations involving Paulette and Kelly Welch, a Mormon couple living in Idaho Falls, Idaho, whose adopted son Stockton died on May 1, 1999 following a fall in their home.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Murder in Spokane
programme.desc: A report that focuses on the murders in Spokane, Washington over a period of a little more than two years (1997 - 1999) of at least a dozen women, mostly prostitutes.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Malmö

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Finland's South Coast

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Kiruna

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: The Faroe Islands

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Åland (Part 2)

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Tornedalen

programme.title: Forensic Files: Once Bitten
programme.desc: Investigators find a shoe print, several foreign hairs and unknown fingerprints at a murder scene. But they believe the most telling piece of evidence is the bite mark on the victim's chest.

programme.title: Forensic Files: All Wet
programme.desc: A woman's death in Pennsylvania triggers a homicide investigation into another woman's death in North Carolina. Faced with striking similarities, examiners must determine if their suspect's story about accidental drowning is all wet.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Shot of Vengeance
programme.desc: A 34-year-old nurse experiences a variety of flu-like symptoms. None of her doctors are able to discover the cause, until she visits her gynecologist for a routine check-up.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dinner and a Movie
programme.desc: Time of death becomes pivotal after a pregnant woman is found murdered in her air-conditioned bedroom. A striking similarity between her death and an HBO movie gives examiners the clues they need to thaw out the alibi of a cold-blooded killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Wrong Foot
programme.desc: Police were puzzled by an obscure print found at a crime scene where one man had been killed and two teenage girls were seriously injured. Neither of the girls could identify their attacker, but one simple clue helped track the footsteps of a killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Order Up
programme.desc: A man is found dead in his home and his ex-wife has a perfect alibi. To determine time of death, investigators need to know when the victim ate his last meal. An endocrinologist, a forensic botanist and a short-order cook answer their question.

programme.title: Forensic Files: When the Dust Settled
programme.desc: Soon after organizing a workers' strike, a union official is executed in his home. Neither his wife nor anyone in the neighborhood hear any gunshots. It takes a forensic sound test, an electron microscope and a nightgown to explain why.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Welcome Intrusion
programme.desc: A man tells police he shot an intruder who had attacked and murdered his wife. The husband paints a tragic picture and is dubbed a hero. Four years later, forensic evidence leads police to re-examine the motives of this so-called hero.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Within Arm's Reach
programme.desc: A police officer accused of killing his estranged wife insists she committed suicide. Investigators say it was murder — that it was physically impossible for the woman to have shot herself.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: Firefighters find an entire family dead inside their home in an apparent murder-suicide, but there are several inconsistent clues in the rubble. Could ballistics, a time card and some secret audiotapes unravel the mystery?

programme.title: Forensic Files: Brotherhoods
programme.desc: Two men are murdered while sleeping in their beds. The next night, arson destroys a family planning clinic. Investigators wonder whether some shards of glass, paint chips and a chicken feather could link what appear to be two separate crimes.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Murdering Cowboy
programme.desc: The sun set on the Wild West long ago, but some people refused to notice. Claude Dallas was one of them. A wily trapper, Dallas typified the rugged individualism that forged this country. He went too far when he killed two game wardens in 1981.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The World Trade Center Bombing
programme.desc: Terrorist bombings are what happen in other countries. Not here in the United States. And yet, in 1993, it happened in New York City.

programme.title: The FBI Files: John Gotti: Convicted
programme.desc: John Gotti was ambitious, powerful and ruthless. He ruled with flash and conspicuous style, playing celebrity with the media and cat and mouse with the FBI. They called John Gotti the Teflon Don. Serious charges just wouldn't stick.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The True Story of Mississippi Burning
programme.desc: Philadelphia, Mississippi, 1964. A sleepy southern town steeped in tradition finds itself targeted for invasion.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Polly Klaas: Kidnapped
programme.desc: On October 1, 1993, a stranger abducted 12-year-old Polly Klaas during a slumber party in her home.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Random Targets
programme.desc: Most victims of multiple murderers are meticulously chosen because of a mutual connection with the killer or because they match an intricate set of criteria that fits the killer's MO.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Texas Rangers
programme.desc: Formed in the 1830s to protect settlers against Indian attack, the Rangers became part of the Texas Highway Patrol in 1935. Their role has continued to evolve to keep up with changing times; today it includes sophisticated forensics labs.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Invisible Death
programme.desc: Poison is an almost invisible form of death, and toxicologists must look for hidden clues in blood and tissue to bring these murders to light.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Broken Trust
programme.desc: A New York homebuyer gets more than he bargained for when a house inspection turns up a mummified corpse. For decades, the crime had gone undiscovered. The victim unmissed, and the killer unpunished.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Deadly intentions
programme.desc: When abduction turns to murder, forensic science is the only key to finding justice for the victims of a kidnapper's deadly intentions.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Lockdown
programme.desc: When a crazed gunman terrorizes his neighborhood, officers put themselves in the line of fire to restore order.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Last Fare
programme.desc: A young man is found dead behind the wheel of his taxi. With robbery seeming unlikely, Kenda and Gaenzle wonder if this was personal.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Sing Sing, Little Bird
programme.desc: A romantic rendezvous is cut short by a violent home invasion, leaving young business owner Kelly Knudson bleeding to death on the floor and Lt Joe Kenda is short on leads.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Powder Kegs
programme.desc: When uninvited guests crash a barrio birthday party, violence erupts—leaving Enrique Urrutia dead and potentially sparking a gang war.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Human Animal
programme.desc: The naked body of a vibrant young mother is found frozen solid in a deserted cemetery. Kenda reopens the investigation and recognizes the sinister hallmark of a serial killer.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Murder in Spokane
programme.desc: A report that focuses on the murders in Spokane, Washington over a period of a little more than two years (1997 - 1999) of at least a dozen women, mostly prostitutes.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Murder They Wrote: The End of the Dream
programme.desc: A report on the charismatic Scott Scurlock, known as “Hollywood” because of his flamboyant style and effective use of disguises in the commission of crimes, successfully eluded capture for four years while effortlessly robbing 18 banks.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Abducted
programme.desc: Focuses on the accounts of two abductions that sparked a worldwide search.

programme.title: 48 Hours: A Cop Behind Bars
programme.desc: Patrick Bradford, was convicted of stabbing his mistress to death. Determined to win his acquittal, Deborah Nolan, a close friend, and staunch supporter of Bradford’s, quit her teaching job and went to law school to take on his defense.

programme.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
programme.desc: An 82-year-old woman appears to have committed suicide by overdosing on painkillers, but Dr. G finds evidence that suggests that she may have died of a heart attack.

programme.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
programme.desc: Dr. G performs an autopsy on an alleged hit-and-run victim but finds no evidence of vehicular injury on the 41-year-old man's body. Could his alcoholism have had a role in his death?

programme.title: Tosh.0: Black Santa
programme.desc: I det här julavsnittet tar Daniel reda på vem som sköt den svarte jultomten, visar sin värsta "jag är bättre än dig, bajs i ditt fejs" och avslöjar ett gammalt familjerecept.

programme.desc: Kyles adopterade bror Ike hämtas tillbaka till Kanada av hans biologiska föräldrar eftersom den nya kanadensiska premiärministern har bestämt att alla barn som adopterats från Kanada måste lämnas tillbaka.

programme.desc: Nathan upptäcker att tomten han brukar hjälpa har en mörk hemlighet. Han försöker marknadsföra en djurpark, med oväntade resultat. Dessutom ertappas en tonåring med att måla graffiti.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: Preparing for War
programme.desc: Hitler unveils his military plans: annex Austria, seize the Sudetenland, and eventually invade Poland and the Soviet Union. By March 1938, Austria falls bloodlessly. By September 1939, he invades Poland, sparking World War Two.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: Hitler's Biggest Blunder

programme.title: Secret War: The Dutch Disaster

programme.title: Secret War: The SAS Italian Job
programme.desc: In 1945, during the Italian Spring offensive, SOE agent Michael Lees and SAS officer Roy Farran led a raid on German HQs at Villa Rossi and Villa Calvi. Despite orders to cancel, Farran attacked with SAS men and partisans, killing many Germans.

programme.title: Brad's Status
programme.desc: Under en resa börjar Brad fundera på ungdomsvännernas rika och glamorösa tillvaro. Hans bekväma och trevliga medelklassliv bleknar i jämförelse. Besvikelsen tar överhanden och han börjar ifrågasätta hur bra hans liv egentligen är.

programme.title: The Female Brain
programme.desc: Den faktaorienterade neuroforskaren Julias forskning om hur den kvinnliga och den manliga hjärnan fungerar illustreras med hjälp av tre olika par. Men Julias fasta övertygelse utmanas när en stilig ny försöksperson deltar i hennes försök…

programme.title: Boomerang: End of the Road

programme.title: Twenties: Redemption Song
programme.desc: Hattie lär sig en läxa om balansen mellan jobb och familj. Nia drar till kyrkan för att städa upp efter Zac, och övertalar basketstjärnan Quintrelle att skriva kontrakt med studion.

programme.title: Twenties: What Would Todd Do?
programme.desc: På improvisationskursen brottas Nia med stereotypiska svarta roller. Ben blir befordrad och Marie undrar varför. Hattie försöker göra sin röst hörd i skrivarrummet.

programme.desc: Maryu Jane och henne kollegor skakas av en skolskjutning med dödsoffer.

programme.desc: Mary Jane blir nominerad till en Emmy, vilket får henne att söka råd hos vänner hon litar på. Snart måste hon bestämma om hon ska följa sin intuition. Samtidigt kommer det fram mer information om Tracy.

programme.title: Being Mary Jane: Primetime
programme.desc: Medan Cynthia är sjukskriven leder och producerar Mary Jane och Kara ett nyhetsprogram på bästa sändningstid. Paul Jr tvingas att välja mellan två jobberbjudanden.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Danmark
programme.desc: Jette bor med sin son i Stubbæk på södra Jylland. Jette känner att hon inte har råd att betala tillbaka till sin syster, men hon har tillräckligt med pengar för att köpa fem nya soffor under ett år.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 2903
programme.desc: Mille i Odense har varit arbetslös under långa perioder eftersom hon har varit tvungen att stanna hemma med sin son. Detta innebär att hon har lånat mycket pengar som nu har vuxit till en enorm skuld.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 2603
programme.desc: Luna är ensamstående mamma till tre barn och har över 20 000 följare på Instagram. Men följarna vet inte att hennes ekonomi är urusel, för Luna köper vad hon vill - även om hon inte har råd.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 2907
programme.desc: Mikkel har varit sjukskriven i flera år, och har därför fått ekonomiskt stöd av sin före detta flickvän Diana. Men vad Diana inte vet är att Mikkel spelar bort alla pengar.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Danmark
programme.desc: Jacobs skulder är enorma, han kan inte sova på nätterna och har tidigare legat på sjukhus med magsår. Han har dyra vanor och trots att hans flickvän har försökt få honom att inse allvaret har det inte slutat.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 2506
programme.desc: Maria och Benjamin är båda 22 år gamla och drömmer redan om ett hus och barn. Men det blir svårt, eftersom både Maria och Benjamin spenderar alla pengar de har, plus lite till, bland annat på spel...

programme.title: Doc Martin: Avsnitt 608
programme.desc: Louisa åker till Spanien, Bert och Jennifer förlovningsfest avslutas med en smäll. Al hyllas som en hjälte för att ha räddat Carolines liv.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Avsnitt 701
programme.desc: Martin återvänder till Portwenn men utan Louisa som har åkt för att bo hos sin mamma i Spanien.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Avsnitt 702
programme.desc: Rachel kanske kan hjälpa Martin att förändra sig. Louisas återvändo gör att relationsfrågor mellan henne och Martin uppstår.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Avsnitt 703
programme.desc: Martin bestämmer sig för att flytta från kirurgin för att ge Louisa det utrymme hon behöver. Louisa blir lite fascinerad av att träffa Martin teapeut vilket snabbt avtar när Rachel föreslår parterapi.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Avsnitt 704
programme.desc: Louisa och Martin har sin första terapisession tillsammans och ingen av dem var förberedda på att det skulle få hemläxa.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Avsnitt 705
programme.desc: Martin når en brytpunkt och Louisa och Morwenna övertalar Martin att hitta ett nytt hem åt Buddy. Martin är inte särskillt imponerad över Angelas alternativa tillvägagångssätt till medicin.

programme.title: Wildfire: Close To Home
programme.desc: The destruction of Kris's trailer by fire forces her to move into the Ritters' house, which brings her closer to an old flame.

programme.title: Wildfire: Love Vs. Work

programme.title: Wildfire: Kiss Kiss
programme.desc: Kris is overcome by emotion when she helps Matt and Junior try to save Flame from being sold by Junior's dad.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Wild West
programme.desc: Allen and Ton explain their strategies at a storage auction in San Bernardino, win two units, then have a Pepperbox gun and vintage Lionel train set appraised by experts.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Ton's Hot Commodity
programme.desc: Allen is late to the auction, leaving Ton to battle a feisty female auction buyer on his own! The guys find a fully functional flamethrower and a rare hand-carved bow and arrow set from South America!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Strat'ed for Cash
programme.desc: On a limited budget in the historic L.A. neighborhood of West Adams, Allen and Ton still win three lockers and find a Maui Blue Fender Stratocaster and a 1930s Schwinn bike.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Viva la Vegas
programme.desc: 1974 death-defying Zig Zag magic sword box, an ultra-rare 1910 poster of the infamous magician Chung Ling Soo, an 1800s naval cane sword and century-old Metlach German beer steins.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Labor of Love
programme.desc: Harley Davidson V-twin EVO engine and revolutionary 1958 dual-suspension swingarm frame; '80s Ms. Pac-Man arcade machine; rare Air Jordan vintage shoe collection in mint condition.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Miami Heat
programme.desc: All-terrain Air Commander Hovercraft, a 1970s NASA countdown clock and a one-of-a-kind 1960s Delta Relay rocket.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Ice, Ice, Baby
programme.desc: Ton and Allen have to get aggressive when they encounter a towering opponent with a mountain of cash. The guys uncover a vintage ice resurfacing machine and an Olympic biathlon rifle!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Voodoo Moola
programme.desc: Allen & Ton hit a storage auction in Louisiana's Capitol City and quickly find themselves in trouble with the law! The guys uncover a pair of racing lawnmowers and then stumble on an antique barber chair from the early 1900s!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Allen's Got Balls
programme.desc: After returning to LA, Ton & Allen head deep into hostile auction hunter territory and butt heads with a familiar old foe! They discover a driving range golf ball picker vehicle and one of the most accurate rifles ever made!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Big Score
programme.desc: At a climate-controlled storage facility in downtown L.A., Allen and Ton's locker wins score them an antique cash register and a German H&K pistol prized by collectors.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Ton's Got a Gun
programme.desc: In the affluent area of Mission Hills, CA, Allen and Ton pick up an estate unit that contains a minibike, a Depression-era slot machine and an 1871 Colt revolver.

programme.title: Defiance
programme.desc: Den otroliga men sanna historien om tre polska bröder som under andra världskriget gjorde motstånd mot den massiva tyska ockupationsmakten, något som räddade tusentals människor.

programme.title: Fortress
programme.desc: Den före detta CIA-agenten Robert lever i ett hemligt sällskap för pensionerade spioner. Nu är hans son Paul i knipa och behöver hans hjälp - men Pauls planer är inte alls lika hemliga som hans fars liv.

programme.title: Fortress: Sniper's Eye: Fortress: Sniper's Eye
programme.desc: Den pensionerade CIA-agenten Robert ger sig ut på ett djärvt räddningsuppdrag för att frita Sasha, änkan till hans gamle ärkefiende. Men väl tillbaka i ledningsbunkern verkar Sasha ha egna svekfulla planer.

programme.title: A Lot Like Christmas
programme.desc: Efter att inte ha träffat sin familj på över sju år övertalas PJ av sina arbetskamrater att åka hem till jul. När han kommer dit återknyter han kontakten med sin high school-kärlek Rebecca.

programme.title: When Hope Calls Christmas
programme.desc: När den lilla staden Brookfield väljs ut av en nationell tidskrift för att uppmärksammas för sin julanda går invånarna samman för att förvandla staden till ett fantastiskt jullandskap.

programme.title: A Chestnut Family Christmas
programme.desc: En privatkock måste hitta på något för att imponera på sin ambitiösa familj innan de kommer för att fira jul med henne.

programme.title: Red Shoe Diaries: Midnight Bells
programme.desc: Claire kan inte glömma den vackra främlingen hon lät komma iväg efter tre nyårsafton tillsammans, den fjärde nyårsafton är hon ensam och när klockorna ringer in det nya året springer hon ut på gatan och söker sin drömman.

programme.title: Two Lovers

programme.desc: Efter att systrarna Ewa och Magda emmigrerat till Amerika 1921 blir Magda sjuk. Ewa faller snabbt offer för den grymme Bruno som tvingar henne till prostitution. Men när Ewa möter Orlando ser hon en möjlighet att komma undan den mardröm hon hamnat i.

programme.title: The Dead Zone: The Man Who Never Was

programme.title: Forensic Files: Brotherhoods
programme.desc: Two men are murdered while sleeping in their beds. The next night, arson destroys a family planning clinic. Investigators wonder whether some shards of glass, paint chips and a chicken feather could link what appear to be two separate crimes.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hair of the Dog
programme.desc: Investigators are baffled after finding a murder scene devoid of any physical evidence, but they suspect that the victim's dog had witnessed the crime. If so, forensic scientists would have to find some way to learn what the dog had seen.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Breaking News
programme.desc: A young TV news producer is raped and murdered in her apartment. Police identify two suspects, but both are cleared of any wrongdoing. When the case stalls for more than a year, investigators turn to the Commonwealth of Virginia's DNA Databank.

programme.title: Forensic Files: All the World's a Stage
programme.desc: Police are dispatched to the scene of a shooting and discover the victim's husband is one of their own: a homicide detective who says his wife accidentally shot herself in the head.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Big Chill
programme.desc: For years, a woman suffered from what appeared to be the unpleasant side effects of lithium, a drug prescribed to treat bipolar disorder. When she died, investigators had to determine if her death was due to natural causes, suicide or murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Bound for Jail
programme.desc: A woman is found dead in a ravine, and crucial evidence has been washed away by severe thunderstorms. Twice, the trail turns cold. Almost 20 years later, an old hat and a chip of stainless steel brings the killer to justice.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sphere of Influence
programme.desc: When an 11-year-old girl disappears from a remote Alaska town, investigators wonder if she has been attacked by a bear or become lost in the dense woods. Eventually, they realize that neither assumption is true.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Nailed
programme.desc: Just weeks before a witness is to testify against the man accused of sexually assaulting her, she is murdered in the front yard of her own home. Investigators immediately suspect her attacker, but they don't have enough evidence to prove his guilt.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sign of the Zodiac
programme.desc: For six years, a serial killer prowled the streets of New York City. He wrote letters to police and The New York Post, indicating he would kill twelve people — one for each astrological sign.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Letter Perfect
programme.desc: A healthy young man dies mysteriously in his sleep and toxicology tests reveal a lethal dose of lidocaine in his blood. Investigators find a suicide note and presume he killed himself until a forensic linguist examines the note.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Polly Klaas: Kidnapped
programme.desc: On October 1, 1993, a stranger abducted 12-year-old Polly Klaas during a slumber party in her home.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Above the Law
programme.desc: California Highway Patrolman George Gwaltney discovered the body of 23-year-old Robin Bishop near her car on a remote desert highway.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Human Prey
programme.desc: Thomas Dillon killed five outdoorsmen at random over a period of three years in rural southern Ohio. After a tip led the FBI to the murder weapon, ballistic testing made a match.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Death in Alaska
programme.desc: The day began like any other for Cheryl and Paul Chapman, until the silence of a peaceful Sunday morning was shattered with a phone call.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Paradise
programme.desc: It should have been Shangri-La, but when bad blood developed, piracy took over and the only law was the law of the jungle.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Deadly intentions
programme.desc: When abduction turns to murder, forensic science is the only key to finding justice for the victims of a kidnapper's deadly intentions.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Traces Of Guilt
programme.desc: Sometimes the scales of justice are balanced by just a few milligrams of evidence: a couple of fibers, a tooth filling, or a smudge on a piece of tape. The biggest cases are often solved by the smallest clues.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Soldier Stories
programme.desc: This show profiles the work of world-renowned forensic experts as they work to tell the stories of the young men who went to war (from the French and Indian war to Vietnam) and never came back.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Vanished
programme.desc: In New York, an ambitious college student has her whole life ahead of her, until she crosses the path of a killer. It's a random murder, the hardest kind to solve.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Undaunted
programme.desc: Solving crimes may begin with gut intuition, but advanced science provides investigators with irrefutable proof. When criminals go to great lengths to mask their crimes, investigators must step up the challenge and remain forever undaunted.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Human Animal
programme.desc: The naked body of a vibrant young mother is found frozen solid in a deserted cemetery. Kenda reopens the investigation and recognizes the sinister hallmark of a serial killer.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: With Friends Like This
programme.desc: A young man is found gunned down outside his home. Sgt. Joe Kenda and Det. John Anderson must determine whether the killer was a complete stranger, a barrio gang member, or a jealous lover.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Preying on the Innocent
programme.desc: When the son of a prominent politician is murdered in his basement, Lt. Joe Kenda feels pressure from City Hall to solve the case.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: A Gathering of Evil
programme.desc: Teen runaway Maggie Fetty is found strangled to death on a mountain road. An anonymous tipster blames Maggie’s best friend, but she accuses a mental patient with multiple personalities.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Death Rains Down
programme.desc: Restaurant worker Sharon Coleman is murdered in a hail of large caliber gunfire. Kenda must break through a web of lies to hunt down one of the most dangerous criminal masterminds he’s ever faced.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Victim Zero
programme.desc: A brawl erupts at a local bar ends with the shooting death of a army solider. To unravel the murder, Lt. Joe Kenda most infiltrate a revered military institution, and expose a dangerous vendetta.

programme.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
programme.desc: Dr. G performs an autopsy on an alleged hit-and-run victim but finds no evidence of vehicular injury on the 41-year-old man's body. Could his alcoholism have had a role in his death?

programme.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
programme.desc: A 94-year-old woman dies in the hospital after having a convulsion. The case becomes the business of the medical examiner's office when no one will sign her death certificate.

programme.title: Evil Twins: Bad Seeds
programme.desc: Robert and Stephen Spahalski are identical twins from New York. One twin is put behind bars for murder as a teen, while the other becomes a serial killer.

programme.title: Evil Twins: My Brother’s Keeper
programme.desc: Greg and Jeff Henry were identical twins that lived identical lives. But one brother shot his twin in a drunken rage. Can twins become too close…ultimately leading to murder?

programme.title: Evil Twins: A Tale of Two Sisters

programme.title: Being Mary Jane: Facing Fears

programme.title: Lyxfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 2804

programme.title: Lyxfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 2507

programme.title: Lyxfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 2901

programme.title: Lyxfällan Danmark

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Ton's Got a Gun
programme.desc: In the affluent area of Mission Hills, CA, Allen and Ton pick up an estate unit that contains a minibike, a Depression-era slot machine and an 1871 Colt revolver.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Sidecar Surprise
programme.desc: An unassuming mom in an oversized sweater tries to pull the wool over Ton & Allen's eyes at a storage auction in Arlington, VA. The guys uncover a black powder cannon designed in the 15th century & a Russian military motorcycle!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Bowling Pin Payday
programme.desc: Allen & Ton visit Ton's old stompin' ground and go head-to-head with a trash-talking auction buyer. They uncover a 19th century rifle with a matching cutlass bayonet and a mechanical bowling pinsetter from the early 1960's!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Chicago Grand Slam
programme.desc: 1984 Yamaha SS440 Snowmobile that introduced the revolutionary shock absorber suspension; rare autographed 1920s baseball glove; mint Hank Aaron signed baseball; authentic 1950s Robby the Robot collector toy.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Big Easy Money
programme.desc: Allen & Ton head to New Orleans in search of easy money, but instead encounter some bayou bidders with big-time bucks! They discover a pair of early 19th-century dueling pistols & a vintage airboat fitted with a turbine engine!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: High Flying Ton
programme.desc: A nerdy auction buyer tests Ton and Allen's patience at a big container auction in Ventura. The guys discover a basket and burners for a hot air balloon and a 19th century German single shot rifle!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Animal Instincts
programme.desc: The first pump action shotgun - a Winchester Model 1897; a hunter's collection of prize big game, full-body taxidermy.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Fire in the Hole!
programme.desc: 1930s "blasting machine" dynamite detonator box; 1890s treasure chest with secret compartments. Ton smelts jewelry to forge bricks of silver.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Hula Moola
programme.desc: Ton and Allen jet to the Hawaiian islands where they're joined by a feisty new female assistant! The team uncovers a pair of James Bond-style gadgets designed for high-speed underwater travel and a vintage sled.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Gold 'n' Gloves
programme.desc: The Auction Hunters team goes toe-to-toe with Ton's evil twin! They find a medieval catapult designed for storming castles and Ton uncovers a hidden collection of gold bars worth thousands of dollars!

programme.title: Fortress
programme.desc: Den före detta CIA-agenten Robert lever i ett hemligt sällskap för pensionerade spioner. Nu är hans son Paul i knipa och behöver hans hjälp - men Pauls planer är inte alls lika hemliga som hans fars liv.

programme.title: Fortress: Sniper's Eye: Fortress: Sniper's Eye
programme.desc: Den pensionerade CIA-agenten Robert ger sig ut på ett djärvt räddningsuppdrag för att frita Sasha, änkan till hans gamle ärkefiende. Men väl tillbaka i ledningsbunkern verkar Sasha ha egna svekfulla planer.

programme.title: Gasoline Alley

programme.desc: I sin jakt på att leva ett ärligt liv, lämnar bankrånaren Tom över sig till polisen. Men han inser snart att de är mer korrupt än han själv och för att rentvå sitt namn måste han nu slå tillbaka.

programme.title: A Chestnut Family Christmas
programme.desc: En privatkock måste hitta på något för att imponera på sin ambitiösa familj innan de kommer för att fira jul med henne.

programme.desc: En kvinna reser tillbaka ett år i tiden till julen innan hennes förlovning bröts och försöker reparera det som gick fel. Hon upptäcker att detta är ett utmanande företag.

programme.desc: Två rivaliserande fastighetsmäklare tvingas samarbeta för att sälja ett speciellt hus, ägt av en känd botaniker och mistelodlare, före jul.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Letter Perfect
programme.desc: A healthy young man dies mysteriously in his sleep and toxicology tests reveal a lethal dose of lidocaine in his blood. Investigators find a suicide note and presume he killed himself until a forensic linguist examines the note.

programme.title: Forensic Files: True Lies
programme.desc: In the summer of 1986, Kathleen Lipscomb's body was found on a deserted road outside of San Antonio. Months and years passed, but the crime was never solved. Finally, a private investigator discovered Kathleen's diary.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Bed of Deceit
programme.desc: A retired police officer is found dead with a single gunshot wound to the head. His wife says the motive was robbery, but later tells police he committed suicide.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Smoke in your Eyes
programme.desc: A suspicious fire sweeps through an apartment, killing two young women. The cause of the fire and the identity of the victims are unclear, but a closer look at the scene reveals something hidden in the ashes.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Flower Power
programme.desc: Two different men called police to report the same murder. Apparently, neither one knew that the other had called. The investigation uncovered even more unusual circumstances.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Past Lives
programme.desc: The body of a wealthy American businessman was found in his rental car. Teeth and bone fragments were the only remains. When the victim's wife files an insurance claim for $7 million, investigators seek the help of a renowned forensic anthropologist.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Over and Out
programme.desc: When a pipe bomb rips through a rural home, police have no idea who is responsible. A 9-volt battery and the remnants of a mailing label ead investigators to the man who made the bomb.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Death by a Salesman
programme.desc: No one in a quiet residential community saw anything unusual the day one of their neighbors was brutally attacked and murdered. Fingerprints found at the crime scene and surveillance video helped investigators to apprehend the presumed killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Web of Seduction
programme.desc: When investigators found Bruce Miller dead in the office of his junkyard business, the crime scene was almost pristine. But when a computer forensics expert examined computers owned by the victim's wife and her lover, he found all the evidence needed.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Grounds for Indictment
programme.desc: A drive-by shooting leaves one man dead and another seriously wounded. Cell phone calls and shell casings point to a suspect, but authorities are unable to place him at the crime scene. A forensic geologist proves that dirt is anything but dumb.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Duelling Confessions
programme.desc: When Rosemary Anderson is found dead on the side of the road, her boyfriend becomes the prime suspect. He eventually confessed to her murder, but so did another man: serial killer Eric Edgar Cooke.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Paradise
programme.desc: It should have been Shangri-La, but when bad blood developed, piracy took over and the only law was the law of the jungle.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Crazy Don
programme.desc: To the FBI, he was believed to be the boss of New York's most powerful mafia organizationthe Genovese crime family. Was Gigante crazy or was his behavior a shrewd attempt to disguise his position as a ruthless mafia boss?

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killing Spree
programme.desc: In 1984, in South Florida, a rapist and murderer was on the loose. The killer was a ruthless and terrifying predator, the newest member of an infamous group known as serial killers.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Melissa Brannen: Missing
programme.desc: In 1989, residents of a close-knit apartment community in Virginia gathered for a holiday celebration. For Tammy Brannen and five-year-old daughter Melissa, Christmas was always a special time. Then without warning, the little girl was gone.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Unabomber
programme.desc: For nearly two decades a mathematical genius with delusions of single-handedly destroying industrial society, planted or mailed powerful bombs to unsuspecting innocent victims.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Undaunted
programme.desc: Solving crimes may begin with gut intuition, but advanced science provides investigators with irrefutable proof. When criminals go to great lengths to mask their crimes, investigators must step up the challenge and remain forever undaunted.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Deadly Dealings
programme.desc: For a price, anything's possible. Contract killings arose out of the need to establish the perfect alibi. By hiring someone else to do the dirty work, a person can deflect guilt, at least in theory.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Lethal Encounter
programme.desc: In most homicides, police rely on motive to pursue a murderer. But when the killer is a stranger the crime may go unsolved for years. It takes a full arsenal of forensic techniques to trace a lethal encounter.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Presumed Dead
programme.desc: What does it take to prove murder if the victim cannot be found? Investigators must go to extreme lengths to catch the killer when the victim is presumed dead.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Deadly Chemistry
programme.desc: The show examines cases of poison and deadly chemistry and shows how forensic experts are solving mysterious deaths today and from the past.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Victim Zero
programme.desc: A brawl erupts at a local bar ends with the shooting death of a army solider. To unravel the murder, Lt. Joe Kenda most infiltrate a revered military institution, and expose a dangerous vendetta.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: The End
programme.desc: Kenda faces his most difficult case yet – the slaying of a young boy. The detective makes the most consequential decision of his career.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Blood Red Highway
programme.desc: The elderly owners of a local grocery are attacked and left for dead. Working with a vague witness description, Lt. Joe Kenda leads a state-wide manhunt to catch a pair of cold-blooded killers.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Trigger
programme.desc: A sharp-dressed pedestrian is shot in the back for unknown reasons. Chasing a promising lead, Kenda realizes he’s barking up the wrong tree.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Bad Moon Rising
programme.desc: The night before Halloween, a real-life nightmare unfolds when a young man is found clinging to life. The case takes a dark turn when Lt. Joe Kenda learns there is a second victim somewhere in the woods.

programme.title: Evil Twins: A Tale of Two Sisters
programme.desc: Identical twins, Sunny and Jeena Han were born just five minutes apart but were bitterly competitive. Jealously and animosity ultimately pushed one twin to order a hit on her sister.

programme.title: Evil Twins: Double Barrel
programme.desc: An officer is murdered in cold blood by identical twins Joel and Michael Stovall. The heavily armed duo lead law enforcement on a stunning, high-speed shootout through the Colorado mountains.

programme.title: On the Case: The Art of Murder
programme.desc: In order to solve the murder of a talented young art student, investigators must first unravel a bizarre web of jealousy and deceit.

programme.title: On the Case: Unmasking a Killer
programme.desc: A beautiful grad student is found murdered inside a yoga apparel store. On the surface it appeared she was the victim of a botched robbery, but remarkable police work revealed a far more sinister plot.

programme.title: On the Case: Mystery In The Desert
programme.desc: When an innocent couple is murdered execution style in the Arizona desert it marks the beginning of a 50 year search for the truth. Who really killed them and why? After decades of investigation the controversial case remains shrouded in mystery

programme.title: South Park: Julesnö
programme.desc: Jultomten stjäl all glädje från stadens julhelg.

programme.title: South Park: Röd släde nedskjuten
programme.desc: Cartman tar jultomten, Mr. Hankey och Jesus till hjälp för att försöka skänka julkänsla till de förtryckta massorna i Irak - allt för att hamna på tomtens lista över snälla barn.

programme.title: South Park: Jul i Kanada
programme.desc: Kyles adopterade bror Ike hämtas tillbaka till Kanada av hans biologiska föräldrar eftersom den nya kanadensiska premiärministern har bestämt att alla barn som adopterats från Kanada måste lämnas tillbaka.

programme.title: Nathan For You: Santa / Petting Zoo
programme.desc: Nathan upptäcker att tomten han brukar hjälpa har en mörk hemlighet. Han försöker marknadsföra en djurpark, med oväntade resultat. Dessutom ertappas en tonåring med att måla graffiti.

programme.title: South Park: Mr. Hankey, julbajskorven
programme.desc: Borgmästaren bestämmer sig för att införa ett oförargligt helgtema som inte väcker anstöt hos någon. Kyle tror att han har svaret.

programme.title: South Park: Mr. Hankeys julklassiker
programme.desc: I det här specialavsnittet visas inslag från Mr Hankeys julalbum.

programme.title: Corporate: Remember Day
programme.desc: Matt bearbetar sitt familjetrauma genom att kasta sig in i kontorets helgfest, Christian ifrågasätter sin världsbild, och Jake överväger att lämna firman.

programme.title: South Park: Skogsdjurens jul
programme.desc: Tomten måste döda de onda djuren i South Park och rädda världen efter att de fått Stan att hjälpa dem med födelsen av deras frälsare.

programme.title: Workaholics: The Strike
programme.desc: När Alice vägrar ge killarna ledigt för fejkhögtiden 'halvjul' bestämmer de sig för att strejka för bättre arbetsvillkor.

programme.title: Anthony Jeselnik - Caligula SV
programme.desc: Den mörka favoritprinsen av komedi, Anthony Jeselnik, låter äntligen pöbeln se hans ståupp. "Anthony Jeselnik: Caligula" filmades på Vic Theatre i Chicago och tar sig an ämnen som de flesta inte ens pratar högt om.

programme.title: iCarly: Matfajten
programme.desc: När Carly, Sam och Freddie besegrar en berömd TV-kock i en matlagningstävling, slutar kocken laga mat, lägger ned sitt matlagningsprogram och vägrar komma ut ur sitt sovrum. Spencer försöker få sin framtidsvision att bli verklighet.

programme.title: iCarly: Jag vill ha min rektor
programme.desc: När Carly, Sam och Freddie av misstag får rektor Franklin avskedad, tar fröken Briggs och magister Howard kontrollen och inför hårda regler. Under tiden anställer Spencer en gammal rodeostjärna som ska lära honom hur man rider på en mekanisk tjur.

programme.title: iCarly: Snabbdejt
programme.desc: Det kommer så många killar till "Gå ut och dansa med Carly"-tävlingen att Carly, Sam och Freddie måste ha snabb-dejter för att hinna träffa dem alla. Spencer följer ett bisarrt träningsprogram från en ny Pearphone-app.

programme.title: iCarly: Jag fixar till en popstjärna
programme.desc: När Carly, Sam och Freddie går med på att göra en musikvideo inför en popstjärnas comeback, upptäcker de att popstjärnan är ur form och saknar talang. Under tiden upptäcker Spencer att kvinnan han dejtar är Gibbys mamma.

programme.title: iCarly: Jag räddade ditt liv
programme.desc: När Freddie räddar Carlys liv, blir Carly kär i honom. Under tiden tävlar Sam och Spencer mot varandra i ett paintballspel som heter Assassin.

programme.title: iCarly: iHittar Lewberts förlorade kärlek
programme.desc: När gänget upptäcker att Lewbert en gång var en lycklig ung man som var förlovad med en vacker kvinna, bestämmer de sig för att återförena de två älskande.

programme.title: iCarly: Jag var en tävlingstjej
programme.desc: Sam avslöjar för Carly och Freddie att hon tävlade i skönhetstävlingar när hon var liten. När hon får veta att hennes gamla rival ska tävla i Seattle övertalar hon Carly att ställa upp mot henne.

programme.title: iCarly: Jag ställer inte in showen
programme.desc: Efter att Sam plötsligt åkt i fängelse, lovar Carly och Freddie dyrt och heligt att inte ställa in webbshowen eftersom hennes pappa ska titta på den. Så Carly ber Spencer hjälpa till, vilket visar sig bli svårt eftersom han har en dejt samma kväll.

programme.title: iCarly: Ute i rymden
programme.desc: En excentrisk miljardär ber Carly och hennes vänner att sända den första webbshowen från yttre rymden, så de får genomgå tester inför rymdresan. Under tiden besöker en underlig liten flicka Spencer hemma i våningen.

programme.title: iCarly: Jag flyttar hemifrån
programme.desc: Freddie bestämmer sig för att flytta hemifrån efter att hans mamma har skämt ut honom; Carly, Sam och Freddie startar ett företag som specialiserar sig på att fotografera husdjur.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Duelling Confessions
programme.desc: When Rosemary Anderson is found dead on the side of the road, her boyfriend becomes the prime suspect. He eventually confessed to her murder, but so did another man: serial killer Eric Edgar Cooke.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Traces of Truth
programme.desc: A mysterious computer crash pushed a thriving manufacturing company to the brink of collapse, jeopardizing hundreds of employees' jobs. Forensic investigators must determine if the crash was the result of a computer defect, human error or sabotage.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Deadly Curve
programme.desc: It was supposed to be a routine motorcade for the Queen of England. But on the way to Yosemite National Park, a car carrying three Secret Service agents collided with a car driven by a deputy from the local sheriff's office.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Visibility Zero
programme.desc: In 1993, the Amtrak Railroad experienced the deadliest train crash in United States history when the Sunset Limited derailed while crossing Alabama's Big Bayou Canot bridge. 47 passengers and crew were killed; scores more were injured.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Flashover
programme.desc: A fire erupts in Kings Cross Station in London, killing 31 people and injuring dozens more. Investigators pinpoint the cause of the fire, but it takes state-of-the-art technology and fluid dynamics experts to explain why it became a deadly inferno.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hack Attack
programme.desc: A mysterious computer crash pushed a thriving manufacturing company to the brink of collapse, jeopardizing hundreds of jobs. Forensic investigators had to determine if the crash was the result of a computer defect, human error, or sabotage.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Road Rage
programme.desc: Police investigate a discarded sleeping bag containing bloody sneakers and a purse, which eventually leads to the body of a young woman. A mark found on the victim's body enables police to track the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hunter or Hunted
programme.desc: A woman is killed while walking her dogs in the woods. Since she has no enemies and her husband has an alibi, police assume it's a hunting accident — until they find a strange letter, allegedly written by the woman before her death.

programme.title: Forensic Files: In Harm's Way
programme.desc: An Alaskan police officer finds a woman's body while on routine patrol of a public park. During the autopsy, the medical examiner preserves the portion of her rib cage which sustained the fatal wound.

programme.title: Forensic Files: No Corpus Delicti
programme.desc: A woman disappears without a trace. Even though foul play is suspected, the leads don't pan out and the trail turns cold. Twenty years would pass before police are able to link a clump of hair discovered in an isolated area with the missing woman.

programme.title: Forensic Files: News at 11
programme.desc: When a talented television news anchor is shot to death outside her home, it appears to be a crime of passion perpetrated by an obsessed fan.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Unabomber
programme.desc: For nearly two decades a mathematical genius with delusions of single-handedly destroying industrial society, planted or mailed powerful bombs to unsuspecting innocent victims.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Murdering Cowboy
programme.desc: The sun set on the Wild West long ago, but some people refused to notice. Claude Dallas was one of them. A wily trapper, Dallas typified the rugged individualism that forged this country. He went too far when he killed two game wardens in 1981.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The World Trade Center Bombing
programme.desc: Terrorist bombings are what happen in other countries. Not here in the United States. And yet, in 1993, it happened in New York City.

programme.title: The FBI Files: John Gotti: Convicted
programme.desc: John Gotti was ambitious, powerful and ruthless. He ruled with flash and conspicuous style, playing celebrity with the media and cat and mouse with the FBI. They called John Gotti the Teflon Don. Serious charges just wouldn't stick.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The True Story of Mississippi Burning
programme.desc: Philadelphia, Mississippi, 1964. A sleepy southern town steeped in tradition finds itself targeted for invasion.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Deadly Chemistry
programme.desc: The show examines cases of poison and deadly chemistry and shows how forensic experts are solving mysterious deaths today and from the past.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Death Grip
programme.desc: Fingerprinting: The Identification Division of the FBI relies on fingerprints as one of the most effective ways to identify criminals.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Missing
programme.desc: Approximately 1.8 million Americans are reported missing each year. Some are runaways who find their way home, but others simply disappear. When foul play is suspected, investigators turn to forensics to find the missing.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Material Witness
programme.desc: Lies and deceit can often throw investigators off the trail of justice. But when hard evidence contradicts a killer's story, police must use the clues to piece together the truth.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Scent Of The Kill
programme.desc: A dog can be a dead man's best friend. Dogs have been trained to sniff out corpses, drugs, explosives, and missing persons. They're often the first to find the essential clue that sets an investigation in motion.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Bad Moon Rising
programme.desc: The night before Halloween, a real-life nightmare unfolds when a young man is found clinging to life. The case takes a dark turn when Lt. Joe Kenda learns there is a second victim somewhere in the woods.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Drive Thru Murder
programme.desc: Missy Berry is found dead in an idling car at a deserted intersection. A surprise twist in the investigation leads him into uncharted territory.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Razor’s Edge
programme.desc: When police find 24-year-old Patrick Ray with a gunshot to the temple, the scene has all the telltale signs of suicide. But Lt. Joe Kenda's instinct says otherwise.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Death Comes Knocking
programme.desc: Neighbors are aghast when Ernestine Addison and her teen son Bobby are gunned down in cold blood. The case heats up when Kenda receives word that the killer’s murderous rampage isn’t over just yet.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: The Uninvited Guest
programme.desc: A soldier is stabbed to death at a drive-thru. Kenda’s only clue is that this is somehow tied to a breakdancing competition.

programme.title: On the Case: Mystery In The Desert
programme.desc: When an innocent couple is murdered execution style in the Arizona desert it marks the beginning of a 50 year search for the truth. Who really killed them and why? After decades of investigation the controversial case remains shrouded in mystery

programme.title: On the Case: Innocent Witness
programme.desc: When Rhonda Boggs is discovered murdered in her own kitchen, police get an important lead from the only witness to the crime, Rhonda's two year old daughter.

programme.title: On the Case: Dirty Secrets
programme.desc: How did seventeen year old Joanna Rogers disappear from her home in the middle of the night? It was a question that baffled the investigators in Lubbock, TX. The mystery may have never been solved without the evidence found during another brutal murder...

programme.title: On the Case: Over The Edge
programme.desc: Police are called to the scene of what appears to be a tragic car wreck in the Blue Ridge Mountains... But as Investigators examine the crash site they realize Wendy Kratzert's death was no accident.

programme.title: On the Case: Taken
programme.desc: In the span of 8 months, 3 young girls are kidnapped from their homes and murdered. When their killer strikes again a young girl's heroic actions solves the case.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Bad Blood
programme.desc: An army vet is found bleeding to death on the asphalt of a parking lot -- his chest littered with too many knife wounds to count. Kenda’s case is stuck in first gear until a gruesome clue appears.

programme.title: Anthony Jeselnik - Caligula SV
programme.desc: Den mörka favoritprinsen av komedi, Anthony Jeselnik, låter äntligen pöbeln se hans ståupp. "Anthony Jeselnik: Caligula" filmades på Vic Theatre i Chicago och tar sig an ämnen som de flesta inte ens pratar högt om.
